Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CRM.
We delivered record revenue of $23.1 billion this quarter, representing 9% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $23.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.73 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $10.2 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
